paper_title: The topological susceptibility in finite temperature QCD and axion cosmology
notes: Lattice QCD calculation (hep-lat) of the topological susceptibility chi_t(T) in 2+1 flavor QCD. The axion content is purely theoretical cosmology: using chi_t and the misalignment mechanism (post-inflationary PQ breaking, theta^2 = pi^2/3, Planck Omega_DM h^2 = 0.1199), the paper estimates f_a <= 1.2e12 GeV (~10% error) so that axions do not exceed the observed dark-matter abundance, shown in Fig. 6 in the T_osc vs f_a plane. This is a theoretical relic-abundance prediction from a first-principles QCD computation, not an experimental or observational exclusion on any axion coupling, and no mass-coupling exclusion curve is presented. Hence is_new_limit is false and no data points are reported.
